breaking_news.headline: How companies can sneak new chemicals past the FDA — and into our food and supplements
breaking_news.summary: There's a sneaky way companies add new chemicals in our food, and it is there by design, and totally legal.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO expected to set record when it goes public Friday
breaking_news.summary: SpaceX will go public on the NASDAQ Friday, likely to set a record as the most valuable IPO in history. NASDAQ is making a big play for IPOs, with new rules aimed at drawing in companies like SpaceX.

breaking_news.headline: Can smartphones help explain the drop in birth rates?
breaking_news.summary: Are smartphones causing people to have fewer children?  A provocative new working paper explores the persistent drop in birth rates since the iPhone was introduced nearly two decades ago.

breaking_news.headline: Door shuts on some immigrant entrepreneurs as U.S. restricts small-business loans
breaking_news.summary: For decades, immigrants who are legal permanent residents in the U.S. could get loans through the Small Business Administration, a core pillar of small-business lending. Not anymore.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO makes history as largest ever. Stock gains 19% on first day
breaking_news.summary: The initial public offering from the rocket and AI company raised some $75 billion, making the company one of the biggest in the world — and likely making Elon Musk a trillionaire.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Dept. approves Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery
breaking_news.summary: The decision paves the way for a proposed $111 billion merger uniting two rival studio giants — Paramount, owner of CBS, and the much larger Warner, which includes HBO and CNN.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount-Warner Brothers merger gets Justice Department approval
breaking_news.summary: The Justice Department closed its investigation into the proposed $110 billion merger of Paramount and Warner Brothers Discovery, saying it found no threat to competition or consumers.

breaking_news.headline: Kennedy Center removes Trump's name from the building
breaking_news.summary: Workers finished removing President Trump's name from the facade of the Kennedy Center early Saturday, hours after a court-ordered Friday deadline to remove references to Trump from the building.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's name removed from Kennedy Center after court order
breaking_news.summary: Crews erected scaffolding on Friday as onlookers gathered into the evening, though storms delayed the work until Saturday.

breaking_news.headline: Woman seriously injured in shark attack at Sydney beach
breaking_news.summary: The woman, 35, was pulled from the water by members of the public and then airlifted to hospital, police say.

breaking_news.headline: Married at First Sight Australia stars not told partners had drug and violence convictions
breaking_news.summary: Stars of the hit TV show say they did not know their on-screen husbands had previous convictions.

breaking_news.headline: Vincent's parents 'never say he's good enough' - so he turned to a middle-aged couple online
breaking_news.summary: A niche group of content creators called "virtual parents" have become hugely popular among young people.

breaking_news.headline: Ticketmaster says Knicks fans won't be locked out of game after last-minute panic
breaking_news.summary: An note on the Ticketmaster website for buying tickets to the game caused confusion and backlash among New Yorkers.

breaking_news.headline: Nigerian author accuses hospital of stalling review into her son's death
breaking_news.summary: Adichie's 21-month old son died in a Lagos hospital, which she says is trying to stop an inquest into the circumstances of his death.

breaking_news.headline: Switzerland to vote on plan to cap population at 10 million
breaking_news.summary: The right-wing Swiss People's Party calls the plan a "sustainability initiative",  but opponents say it is a recipe for chaos.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says US-Iran deal to be signed on Sunday as Tehran casts doubt on timing
breaking_news.summary: The US president's comments come as Iran says an exact date has not been decided, but it "will not be tomorrow".

breaking_news.headline: Watch: Three things to know about SpaceX's stock market debut
breaking_news.summary: The BBC's Samira Hussain explains everything you need to know about SpaceX's historic IPO.

breaking_news.headline: My friends always want to split the bill equally, how do I say no?
breaking_news.summary: It is never easy to speak up when a fellow diner says "let's just divide it!"

breaking_news.headline: India's 'blue gold' starts a new drinks industry
breaking_news.summary: Agave plants grow wild in India and new distillers are using them to create a spirits industry.

breaking_news.headline: Why the economics make this the craziest World Cup ever
breaking_news.summary: From trade wars to soaring ticket prices, the 2026 World Cup is unlike any before it. Faisal Islam explores what this tournament reveals about our changing global economy.
